brief:
The United Kingdom has cancelled the travel authorisation of Swedish academic and pro-Palestine activist Andreas Malm, preventing him from entering the country, Middle East Eye reported. Malm had been scheduled to appear at a pro-Palestine event in Britain.

The denial comes as the UK government faces ongoing scrutiny over its approach to pro-Palestinian speech and activism. Details regarding the specific grounds for the entry denial were not immediately clear.
